question:
**Ddirection: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

The lens in this collection is focused very carefully upon the (quotidian), with all of its utterly familiar vexations.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3** i.e**. Sporadic'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quotidian"** means daily or everyday (रोज़ाना). 
 
• When searching for an antonym for this word, we find **'Sporadic'** which means happening at irregular intervals (अनियमित). 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'Sporadic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandatory** means required by law or rules, obligatory (अनिवार्य).
 
• **Normal** means conforming to a standard; usual, typical, or expected (सामान्य).
 
• **Obligatory **means required by a legal, moral, or other rule; compulsory (अनिवार्य).
